step1_analysis.circuit_type: High-Frequency CML Clock Divider (Injection-Locked / Miller Divider)
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed current-mode logic (CML) clock divider circuit. It utilizes a mixer-like structure with cross-coupled pairs to enable self-oscillation, allowing it to divide very high frequency clocks (up to 38 GHz) by 2.

paper_reference.title: High-Frequency CML Clock Dividers in 0.13-m CMOS Operating Up to 38 GHz

operating_frequency.description: The maximum input clock frequency that the circuit can successfully divide by 2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends heavily on transistor sizing and parasitic capacitance. With W/L=5u/0.5u, the fT is lower than minimum length devices, so expected max frequency is around 20 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper achieved 38 GHz in 130nm, but the extracted netlist uses L=0.5u which significantly limits speed. 20 GHz is a conservative estimate for this specific netlist.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the divider from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With Vbias=1.2V, tail currents are ~0.86mA each. 3 tails * 0.86mA = 2.58mA. 2.58mA * 1.8V = 4.6 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and the specific Vbias applied in the testbench.

divide_ratio.description: The ratio of the input clock frequency to the output frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: By design, this topology is a divide-by-2 circuit.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the divided output signal.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CML logic levels typically aim for 300mV to 600mV swing to keep transistors out of deep triode region.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify divide-by-2 operation at 20 GHz, measuring input/output frequencies, power consumption, and voltage swing. Missing feedback connections (LABEL_NETs) are wired externally to form the complete Miller/ILFD divider topology.
step3_testbench.spice:
* High-Frequency CML Clock Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT Params
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

* DUT Netlist
XM1 N3 N9 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N7 LABEL_NET_1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N11 LABEL_NET_2 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N11 LABEL_NET_3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_4 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N12 LABEL_NET_5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N11 LABEL_NET_6 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N9 LABEL_NET_7 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N6 LABEL_NET_8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N8 LABEL_NET_9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

* Testbench Wiring & Sources
V_VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Bias for tails
V_L8 LABEL_NET_8 0 1.2
V_L9 LABEL_NET_9 0 1.2

* Clock Inputs (20 GHz)
V_L0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 1.2 sin(1.2 0.4 20G 0 0 0)
V_L1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 1.2 sin(1.2 0.4 20G 0 0 180)

* Cross-coupled pair feedback (Self-oscillation)
E_L3 LABEL_NET_3 0 N12 0 1
E_L5 LABEL_NET_5 0 N11 0 1

* Amplifier inputs
E_L7 LABEL_NET_7 0 N11 0 1
E_L4 LABEL_NET_4 0 N12 0 1

* Feedback to mixer
E_L2 LABEL_NET_2 0 N0 0 1
E_L6 LABEL_NET_6 0 N9 0 1

* Fix for XM9 (tail of buffer) which has gate tied to GND in extracted netlist
I_tail3 N1 0 1m

* Fix for XM10 typo in netlist (drain should be N12 for differential symmetry)
XM10_fix N12 LABEL_NET_6 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Load Resistors (Pull-ups to VDD)
R1 N11 VDD 500
R2 N12 VDD 500
R3 N9 VDD 500
R4 N0 VDD 500
R5 N3 VDD 500
R6 N4 VDD 500

* Control Block
.control
  tran 1p 5n
  
  * Power Measurement
  meas tran avg_current avg i(V_VDD) from=2n to=5n
  let power = -avg_current * 1.8
  print power
  
  * Differential vectors for robust frequency measurement
  let v_in_diff = v(LABEL_NET_0) - v(LABEL_NET_1)
  let v_out_diff = v(N3) - v(N4)
  
  * Input frequency
  meas tran t_in_1 trig v_in_diff val=0 rise=20 targ v_in_diff val=0 rise=21
  let f_in = 1 / t_in_1
  
  * Output frequency
  meas tran t_out_1 trig v_out_diff val=0 rise=10 targ v_out_diff val=0 rise=11
  let f_out = 1 / t_out_1
  
  * Divide Ratio
  let div_ratio = f_in / f_out
  print f_in f_out div_ratio
  
  * Output swing
  meas tran v_max max v(N3) from=3n to=5n
  meas tran v_min min v(N3) from=3n to=5n
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  print v_swing
  
  quit
.endc
.end
